name: REL-SYNTH-LC-20261102:local-repair-control

Task.scope: Independent optical-powered cold-chain air-point history task. Numeric services are requirements to test, not a feasibility statement or inheritance of A/R qualification.

service.new_sample_receive_scope: Every sample acquired while gateway is available must be received within10s of acquisition; no frame-label exemption.
service.temperature_reference: independent air-point truth at actual acquisition time
service.timestamp_requirement: Known absolute acquisition time or an uncertainty interval containing truth with width<=120s and midpoint error<=60s; UNKNOWN time fails this strict service.
service.history: All committed records retained; pre-recovery unacknowledged records delivered by 64920 in acquisition order without duplicate logical samples.
service.gap_markers: Must describe known missing intervals but do not satisfy continuous sampling.

optical_environment.spatial_scope: Uniform attenuation over every cell; nonuniform substring shading/mismatch is MODEL_DOMAIN until a per-cell reference is bound.
optical_environment.source_identity: Constructed public spectrum; not an Epishine characterization lamp or a measured cold-chain light trace.

required_characterization: I-V at declared spectrum, irradiance and cell temperature
PMIC cold-start, input loading, conversion and leakage
pv_consumer_contract.missing_profile_result: MODEL_UNKNOWN; no constant pulse/power substitute or inferred watts from lux.

thermal_reference.model_scope: Local probe-to-air lag and quantization only; contents-core temperature, full box CFD, external-to-internal heat transport and self-heating are not certified.
thermal_reference.sensor_reading: Program obtains sensor temperature only at powered acquisition events; it cannot read ideal air truth or retrospective samples.

clock_reference.scope: Constructed bounded oscillator assumption. RTC continuation must consume power; no oscillator advance through unpowered periods without an explicit powered retention domain.
clock_reference.resynchronization: Only an actual available-gateway sync event can restore absolute time; every failed or unknown timestamp remains in evaluation.

generation_rules_for_S0.public_development_template: The explicit schedules in this draft are one constructed template, not a held-out test.
generation_rules_for_S0.holdout_generation: S0 owns seed-to-split binding before H formation. No held-out realizations or outcomes are generated by A in Stage1.
generation_rules_for_S0.dependent_windows: For a variant, gateway recovery is dark_start+43200, old-history deadline is recovery+120; gateway outage begins no later than dark_start. Deadlines remain relative to the same physical recovery.
generation_rules_for_S0.exposure: Freeze DOOR-derived H before first LC-PV result; any target-data adaptation uses a separately named condition/budget and fresh unexposed tests.

requires_rebinding: all service values and independent evaluator inputs
not_inherited: mechanical source or calibrated physical claim

qualification_gaps: Measured/calibrated profile, switching, physical RF/MCU/NVM and continuous-grid convergence remain outside this discrete-world claim.

sources.role: Primary vendor I-V/spectral-condition reference; no product performance copied into constructed spectrum.

Task.next_owner: S0 common host; at most one initial, no replacement.
Task.description: Stable illumination outside the original twelve-hour dark interval and continuously available link remove shadow/outage interactions; strict energy, sample, timestamp and service requirements remain.

generation_receipt.rule: Explicit new joint light/shadow/darkness/connectivity/thermal/clock block, selected before one initial observation and all H0 results.
generation_receipt.exposure: New development realization, not a held-out F2 test; allowed_for_learning=false.

Profile.provenance: Prospective explicit constructed coefficients, not a fitted/vendor/physical device profile; no old A/R qualification inherited.

pv.temperature_scope: Only the declared fixed 25 C PV junction, no unbound temperature scaling.

pmic.relation: OFF: Vin=1.8V; ON: Vin=1.8+Vstore/5, diode I(Vin), Pbus=.75*Vin*I. Idealized controlled input loading, no MPPT/switching or specific PMIC claim.

load.scope: Declared regulated-output energy impulses with positive completion durations, ESR/dropout and conversion guards; background includes a current-availability gateway beacon listener. No compiled MCU, RF, switching or NVM device calibration.

Program.clock_continuation: Only while powered; reset loses synchronization; no unpowered clock.
Program.gateway_beacon: Current available beacon while powered; charged sync phase on initial/new availability. No future schedule access.
Program.storage: Atomic SAVE/ACK after paid completion; interrupted pending write discarded; persistent image survives reset only when enabled.

purpose: BOLD pre-frozen independent prospective development condition; unchanged consumer and strict evaluator.
